oak: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: a single seamless wood beam side texture for a Minecraft medieval timber-framing mod. Flat orthographic material tile filling the entire square, no perspective, no object silhouette, no border, no text. 32 by 32 pixel art magnified to fill the image, sharply discrete pixels, restrained vanilla Minecraft scale. Continuous straight vertical wood grain from top to bottom, narrow irregular growth lines and subtle worn tool marks. This is sawn/hewn solid timber: no bark, no plank seams, no board divisions, no metal, no nails. Low contrast so many beams can meet cleanly. Seamless on every edge. Palette: medium warm weathered oak brown. Uniform ambient light; no cast shadows, no gradients.
